scenario: `cached()` is allowed in `where` clauses per LSTO.4.3.1a: `where cached("armed") == "true"` compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: nothing is read. What a miss reads as is the logical/LSTO.4.3.1a.* vectors'.
rules_ds:
schema Trigger scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule arm_check:
    Trigger where cached("armed") == "true"
->
    log info "armed system triggered"
